marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Wednesday.
marine.text:
Wind southwest 20 knots veering to northwest 15 early this
afternoon then diminishing to light early this evening. Wind increasing to
northeast 20 late overnight and to northwest 30 near noon
Wednesday. Rain beginning overnight becoming snow or rain near noon
Wednesday then flurries Wednesday evening. Fog patches forming this evening and
dissipating Wednesday morning. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Today Tonight and Wednesday.
marine.text:
Seas 1 to 2 metres subsiding to 1 or less late this afternoon
then building to 1 to 2 Wednesday morning.<br/>
